head_commit_message:
Move to the one-job advisor setup and add the re-dispatch cycle

One carbon-advisor job (no config file, no checkout) gives the real GITHUB-HOSTED answer and the labelled GB scenario; redispatch: scenario-demo records SCENARIO deferrals as carbon-deferral issues, the build is skipped, and carbon-dispatch.yml re-runs it at the deferred commit. whatif.yml uses mode: whatif. Pins senith02/Artifact 85e43ea (research DL-038).
